text: みずに　はいる　まえに　じゅんび　たいそう　しなきゃ！
note: じゅんびたいそう is the set warm-up routine Japanese children do at school before swimming lessons, so the line sounds like a rule everyone was taught at the pool.
claim: In Japanese schools, swimming lessons begin with warm-up exercises called junbi taisō before students enter the pool.

check.quote: 一般に準備運動をして体温を上げ、シャワーを浴びて汗を流してからプールに入ります。
